title: Hold the Set, Pin the Judge
tagline: Correctness of the content and reliability of the shape are different axes. Measure both.

story.problem: A cheaper classifier won an accuracy sweep and was promoted on the strength of a tie, then failed 4 of 30 structured-output calls — a failure an accuracy score reads as a tie rather than as a fault.
story.solution: A held labelled set, a judge pinned to its own environment variable so a model swap cannot move the bar, shape conformance probed as a separate axis, and one stack-blind grader that scores any system emitting the shared RunResult contract.
story.outcome: Two different architectures scored on the same brief by identical code, and a model promotion reversed thirteen minutes later on evidence rather than on preference.

prerequisites: Recipe 01 — the judge is a role in the model registry, not a constant
Node 24.x and npm install at the repo root
A Nebius Token Factory key as NEBIUS_API_KEY in .env.local
A labelled set with ground truth — fifteen real vendor replies ship in evals/data/vendor-replies.json
A running deployment for the evals that drive full turns

quickstart.run: npm install && npm run eval:replies && npm run probe:schema
